question: Which place in the north-eastern part of the northern Indian state of Himachal Pradesh is popularly known as the Cold Desert Mountains?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spiti Valley**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Spiti Valley** is the **cold desert mountain valley** in the northeastern part of Himachal Pradesh that is known as the Cold Desert Mountains: 
 
• **Spiti Valley is in the rain shadow region of the Greater Himalayan ranges.**
 
• It is **bordered by Kinnaur to the southeast, Kullu to the south, and the valleys of Zanskar and Ladakh to the north.**
 
• The valley shares a boundary with Tibet to the east. 
 
• The **name "Spiti" means "The middle land",** which is the land between India and Tibet. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parvati Valley**

 
 
• **​Parvati Valley is situated in the northern Indian state** of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• From the confluence of the **Parvati River with the River Beas**
 
• The** Parvati Valley runs eastwards, t**hrough a steep-sided valley from the town of Bhuntar, in the Kullu district of Himachal Pradesh in Northern India
